changed: no-op and invalid edits preserve exact old data
completion, schema1 rejection, schema2 reader and fresh-process reopen
retained: previous implementation reads new data without rewriting
v1/v2 imports, v1 cross-reader/export, explicit migrate, late invalid import
recovery: injected pre-rename failure; retry; explicit disposable data restore
limits: same-agent source-exposed Node fixture; manual impact map; no model comprehension, real disk denial, crash, concurrency or global compatibility claim
